scopeNote: Blocking identifies a decision that must be resolved before the affected behavior is baselined or the story is accepted for production. It does not automatically block unrelated discovery or implementation work. Independent filter optionality and the minimum of one completed search criterion are separate assumptions.
resetScope: Blocks approval of the independent reset transition and its search-contract behavior, not unrelated filter work. The existing non-blocking question concerns the reset mechanism, conditional on reset being approved.

criteria.title: Select the same month as both boundaries
steps: Given an available month is selected as the provisional start
When the consumer selects that same month again
Then the start and end refer to the same month
And the filter displays a completed one-month range
And the other filters remain unchanged

criteria.title: Start a new range after completing a range
criteria.scenario: Replace a completed range with a new provisional start
steps: Given a completed departure month range is selected
When the consumer opens the date filter and selects an available month
Then that month becomes the new provisional start and the previous end is cleared
And the previous completed range no longer restricts the search
And the date filter displays Any Date until a new end is selected
And the panel remains open and the other filters remain unchanged

criteria.title: Span an unavailable intermediate month
criteria.scenario: Select available boundaries around an unavailable month
steps: Given two available boundary months surround an intermediate month without sailings
When the consumer selects those boundaries as the start and end
Then the inclusive range is accepted
And the unavailable intermediate month remains disabled as a selectable boundary
And the range does not imply that sailings exist in every included month
And only sailings matching the selected criteria are expected on the results page

criteria.title: Search with a provisional date selection
criteria.scenario: Search with another completed criterion and an incomplete date range
steps: Given a destination or departure port is selected and only a provisional start month is selected
When the consumer selects Search Cruises
Then the search uses the completed destination and/or port criteria
And the provisional date selection is excluded from the search criteria
And the date filter continues to display Any Date
And the component retains the provisional start for completion or reset; persistence after navigation remains subject to confirmation
criteria.extraScenario: Attempt to search with only a provisional date selection
extraSteps: Given no destination or departure port is selected and only a provisional start month is selected
When the consumer selects Search Cruises
Then the search is not initiated and the consumer is informed that at least one completed criterion is required
And the provisional start remains available for completion or reset

questions.question: May a departure range include an unavailable intermediate month when both boundaries are available?
questions.assumption: Yes. Availability controls selectable boundary months; an inclusive range may span a month with no sailings. This is a proposed assumption, not an explicit source requirement (ASM-06; US4 AC12).
questions.reason: A date interval does not guarantee a sailing in each month. Confirming this rule avoids different validation behavior in the selector and search capability.
questions.scope: Blocks approval of range validation and the date-search contract, not destination or port selection.

questions.question: Should a search proceed with other completed criteria while a date range is still provisional?
questions.assumption: Yes. Send only completed criteria and omit the provisional date. A provisional start alone does not satisfy the separately assumed minimum-selection rule. In the demo, the provisional start is retained for completion or reset; persistence across real navigation requires confirmation (ASM-07; US5 AC6).
questions.reason: A provisional month is not an applied restriction. Explicitly distinguishing partial state from completed criteria prevents accidental filtering or unexpected blocking.
questions.scope: Blocks approval of search eligibility, criterion transfer and provisional-state persistence; unrelated selector work can continue.

evidenceNote: Specification coverage is not integration evidence. The prototype demonstrates local selection, validation and simulated criterion transfer. It does not verify real navigation to /cruises, results-page preselection or server-side filtering. US5 integration acceptance remains pending until those behaviors are tested against the actual search capability.
